text: {"lessons":["My account fell from 97,278 to 75,678 without any trades, reminding me that holding still does not prevent losses; I should periodically assess whether my exposure fits my risk tolerance and time horizon.","Avoiding impulsive trades can be sensible, but rarely checking my account may leave risks or concentration unaddressed; I should review it regularly without reacting to every monthly move.","I should base future decisions on diversification, longer-term prospects, and clear goals rather than trying to predict short-term price changes or recover losses quickly."]}
